title: Penguins

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Penguin
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Penguins are birds. They cannot fly, but they swim very well. They use their wings to swim under the water. Penguins eat fish and other food from the sea.
Penguins live in the south of the world, for example in Antarctica and New Zealand. Penguins lay their eggs and take care of their babies on land.
All penguins have a white belly and a black back. The biggest penguin is the emperor penguin. It can be nearly 110 centimetres tall. The smallest penguin is only about 32 centimetres tall.
